verdict.rationale: The only org-level control in the evidence is a single security-doc line about controlling which destinations team computers can reach. That is a thin, team-scoped network/data policy; Team Bots exist, but nothing shows member management or an admin permission console. Approval rules (Allow/Always allow/Deny, Auto-review) are per-user action approvals, which is an adjacent feature, not workspace administration. Missing for 10: member invite/removal and role management, org-wide permission administration, explicit data retention/usage policies, and any independent corroboration of admin controls.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace

citations.quote: It controls which destinations team computers can reach.
Each Team Bot has its own handle, so you can invite it to a channel where everyone can ask questions, contribute context, and see its responses.
